title: The Bright Signal Walk
question: 把今天“没有手机帮助 -> 保持冷静 -> 把物品变成信号 -> 在雪地上做大标记 -> 很快有人赶来”的表达，放进 winter outdoor activity 场景：用 word bank 补完整 5 个空。
example_answer: During a winter outdoor activity, we needed to send a signal because the phone signal was weak. We turned a jacket into a flag and stood together. I stayed as calm as I could while my classmates stamped out big letters in the snow. It was not long before a park worker arrived and guided us back.
word_bank: turned a jacket into a flag
stamped out big letters in the snow
It was not long before a park worker arrived
